items.originalExcerpt: At least 14 tankers linked to Russia's so-called "shadow fleet" sailed through Bulgarian and Romanian waters during the first seven months of 2026, spending a combined 418 hours in the territorial waters of the two countries, according to an analysis by Greenpeace Bulgaria. items.title: Bulgaria Eyes Bearded Vulture as Eurovision 2027 Symbol
items.excerpt: The bearded vulture could become Bulgaria's symbol for Eurovision 2027, with the Green Balkans association proposing the endangered species as a distinctive emblem for the contest, which will be held in Burgas next year.
items.originalTitle: Bulgaria Eyes Bearded Vulture as Eurovision 2027 Symbol
items.originalExcerpt: The bearded vulture could become Bulgaria's symbol for Eurovision 2027, with the Green Balkans association proposing the endangered species as a distinctive emblem for the contest, which will be held in Burgas next year. The proposal is linked to efforts to restore the bearded vulture in Bulgaria and the remarkable story of Boev, a bird that left the country, traveled across Europe and eventually returned after covering more than 14,000 kilometers.
